description: Return the patient's past medical-test rows (id, test type, test date, risk level, summary, status, abnormal-marker count). Bearer token must be a Mediora patient-scope JWT. Paginated; default 10 per page. Proxies https://api.mediora.ai/api/medical-tests with the user's token forwarded as Authorization: Bearer.

page_size.description: Items per page. Defaults to 10, max 50.
